title: Yann LeCun says Llama 4's "results were fudged a little bit", and that the team used different models for different benchmarks to give better results (Melissa Heikkilä/Financial Times)
summary: Melissa Heikkilä / Financial Times: Yann LeCun says Llama 4's “results were fudged a little bit”, and that the team used different models for different benchmarks to give better results — The AI pioneer on stepping down from Meta, the limits of large language models — and the launch of his new start-up
contentText:
Melissa Heikkilä / Financial Times :

Yann LeCun says Llama 4's “results were fudged a little bit”, and that the team used different models for different benchmarks to give better results   —  The AI pioneer on stepping down from Meta, the limits of large language models — and the launch of his new start-up
